text.tspan: The Falcon030 contains an 8530 Serial Communications Controller (SCC) that provides a dual
channel, multi-protocol device that provides a serial port and network LAN port. The
input/output of the serial port is routed to a 9-pin connector. The input/output of the LAN port is
